notes: Sheet is north-up (compass at top left). Top band is Eden Park. PARKSIDE (E. COURT) PL. (50') runs along the park from Louden (L-corner) east past Morrill to the right edge. LOUDEN (PARALLAX) AV. (50') runs from Parkside south across Paradrome to Hatch (T). ELGIN PL. (EDEN PARK CT.) (60') runs down the left side; only its west edge region overlaps sheet 143. Paradrome is offset at Elgin: the west part (from sheet 143, centre y~1177; width not printed here, 50 ft on 143) and the east part (40', centre y~1364-1389) running east across Louden and Morrill to the right edge; the east part is suffixed '(east of Elgin)'. HATCH (40') runs from Elgin east across Morrill/Carney to the right edge; St. Gregory, Louden, Belvedere and Fuller T into it. South of Hatch the 50 ft lots street is printed CARNEY (40'); north of Hatch the same line is printed MORRILL (50'), with lot numbers 1201-1235 continuing Carney's 1101-1143 (a corner lot is pasted 1201 CARNEY), so the street was being renamed; both names recorded at Hatch. E. COURT (60') enters from the bottom left (toward sheet 128) and ends at Elgin's south end; the 310 elevation sits in this junction on both 128 and 129. ST. GREGORY (40'), BELVEDERE (40') and FULLER (40') run from Hatch to PAVILION (40', centre y~4284-4295); all three lean slightly (x grows ~20-30 px from Hatch to Pavilion). St. Gregory continues south of Pavilion onto sheet 128 and Pavilion continues west of St. Gregory (sheet 128), so that one is a cross. At the bottom right Pavilion turns NE; CARNEY (FORT VIEW PL.) (35', paste-over) runs SW from Carney's south end to Pavilion's E-W leg, parallel to and NW of Pavilion's NE leg, separated from it by a drawn line. An unlabelled ~16 ft strip runs SW from the Pavilion/Fort View junction to the bottom edge (recorded as alley, width not printed). BOWLING ALLEY at x~2400 y~4000 is a building, not a street. Pencilled permit notes near the bottom ignored. Scale ~3.44 px/ft.
